description: Combined prospective validation N=15 (original N=10 + new N=5 kinase batch)

methodology.original_N10: 2024-2025 FDA NMEs with single-dose or manually AR-corrected Cmax; 9 in-domain, 1 AD-flagged
methodology.new_N5: 2024-2025 FDA NMEs identified via openFDA API systematic extraction; all steady-state Cmax back-calculated to single-dose using FDA-reported accumulation ratios

honest_finding: Original N=10 cohort biased toward PK-easy drugs (short t1/2 or direct single-dose FDA data). Adding 5 kinase inhibitors requiring SS→single-dose back-calculation reveals Sisyphus prospective AAFE 2.478, much closer to holdout in-domain 2.74 than earlier N=10 suggested. The apparent prospective advantage was partly selection bias.

vorasidenib.notes: SS Cmax 133 ng/mL / AR 4.4 (AR_AUC, t1/2=10d). Very long t1/2 makes AR uncertain.

crinecerfont.notes: SS Cmax 4231 ng/mL / AR 2.94 (BID, t1/2~20h). Also EXTREME_LIPOPHILIC flag.

revumenib.notes: SS Cmax 2344 ng/mL (270mg BID, no CYP3A4 inh) / AR 2.0

scientific_interpretation: 4/5 new drugs: Sisyphus under-predicts by 2-6x (pirtobrutinib, pacritinib, crinecerfont, revumenib)
1/5: Sisyphus over-predicts by 4x (vorasidenib, very long t1/2 creates uncertainty in AR correction)
These 5 drugs are kinase inhibitors / protein-targeted drugs with moderate-to-high MW (400-640 Da)
Systematic under-prediction consistent with 2.283 baseline AAFE — engine+ML pipeline has ~2-3x random error envelope
The 1.68 in-domain prospective AAFE from N=10 was selection-biased; honest prospective AAFE closer to 2.5
limitations: AR correction introduces uncertainty (~20-50%) in observed value back-calculation
All 5 new drugs are SS-corrected, not true single-dose measurements
FDA label values are aggregate population means (CV% 32-73%)
Reference values for 2 drugs (vorasidenib, pacritinib) also warrant independent verification
